user.title: Samsung Soundbar Local
user.description: Set up local control of your Samsung soundbar. Make sure IP control is enabled in the SmartThings app.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the soundbar.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave disabled unless you have installed a trusted certificate on the soundbar.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the soundbar. Check the host and that IP control is enabled.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll the soundbar for state updates (5-300 seconds).
